description: Accept the Dataset License Agreement for a quoted order on the buyer's behalf. Call ONLY after the buyer explicitly approves the tier, clip count, price, and the full agreement text. Paid tiers move to awaiting_payment; the free evaluation sample goes straight to Stockfilm's manual review.

agreement_sha256.description: sha256 of the agreement text the buyer reviewed (from get_dataset_agreement or describe_training_dataset). Proves the current version was shown.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves the tier, clip count, price, and the full agreement text.

legal_name.description: Legal name of the licensee organization

order_token.description: Private order_token returned by quote_training_dataset. Keep it private.

signer_name.description: Name of the person authorizing the purchase on the licensee's behalf

name: accept_dataset_agreement
